newsitem.title: USA: Western Water to sell land in Nevada.
newsitem.headline: Western Water to sell land in Nevada.

text.p: Western Water Co on Monday said it and an affiliate of investment brokerage firm Morgan Stanley have agreed to sell their interest in Nevada Land & Resource Co LLC, owner of over 1.3 million acres and associated natural resources in Nevada.
The buyer, investment firm Global Equity Corp of Toronto will own 75 percent of Nevada Land and its U.S. affiliate, PICO Holdings Inc, will acquire the remaining 25 percent.

Western Water's share of the purchase price will be $13.3 million, of which $12 million will be paid in cash and the balance by a Global convertible note due on Dec. 31, 1997. In conjunction with the sale, Western Water and a Morgan Stanley affiliate will assist Global in developing water and mineral resources on the Nevada property in exchange for a 50 percent interest in the net proceeds after Global recoups its investment and receives a specified rate of return.
An affiliate of Morgan Stanley also has agreed to provide Western Water with a three-year right of first offer to review water investment opportunities in the western United States.
